title: Material
description: A crafting material for weapons, armor, and accessories. Each material has a five-phase element and the modifiers it confers on a crafted item: bonuses to attack (0 to +10 range for weapons; see attack property for details), to defense, and/or to the magnitude of effects (enchantments) channeled through it. Consumed by the crafting and magic-crafting modules; the material's phase interacts with phased effects via data/wuxing.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

phase.description: The material's element. Required — every material has one. A crafted item carries its material's phase, so effects enchanted into it interact with other phases via the cycles in data/wuxing (e.g. a Metal blade amplifies a Water enchantment through the generating cycle).

tier.description: Quality/rarity tier; higher is rarer and generally stronger.

appliesTo.description: Which kinds of item can be crafted from this material.

modifiers.description: Bonuses the material confers on the crafted item. All optional; a material declares whichever apply (at least one).

attack.description: Bonus to the item's attack/damage rating (weapons). This is the material's contribution to weapon attack power. Range is 0 (floor for materials that provide no direct combat bonus, e.g. gold or wood for arms) to +10 (maximum; none of the current materials reach +10). Typical values: wood 0 (structural/haft material), bronze +2, iron +3, steel +5, obsidian +6 (sharp but brittle).

defense.description: Bonus to the item's defense/armor rating (armor, shields). May be negative.

effectMagnitude.description: Fractional bonus to the magnitude of effects enchanted into the item (magic conduction). e.g. 0.15 = +15%.

weightFactor.description: Multiplier on the base item weight (1.0 = neutral; <1 lighter, >1 heavier).

valueFactor.description: Multiplier on the base item value/cost.
